AC76-0628: Looking up from a hillside inside a giant spherical space habitat, the curved inner surface is covered with forests, villages, farmland and a winding river, rising overhead toward a bright window ring and a cylindrical hub at the center. In the foreground a group of people in casual clothes gathers around a buffet table on a terrace.
ARC-1974-AC73-9344: A small spacecraft follows a thin white trajectory line past the Sun toward a banded giant planet with a red spot, while a small blue-green planet sits on the far side of the orbit. Swirling bands of reddish asteroid debris and dust sweep across the dark background.
ARC-1975-AC75-1085: A huge space station floats against a starfield with drifting red nebulae: a large conical mirror, a central sphere with docked modules, long angled solar panels, and a chain of linked pods curving in a ring around it. Two small moons hang in the lower background.
ARC-1975-AC75-1086-1: Inside a ring-shaped space colony, terraced white houses, gardens and trees line the curved floor that rises up and away into the distance. Overhead, a broad band of slanted window panels glows with bands of yellow and orange sunlight, and a support spoke stretches toward a hub against a starry red nebula.
ARC-1975-AC75-1086: View down the length of a cylindrical space habitat: green rolling farmland, a lake with an island and a winding river cover the curved floor, while the land continues up the walls and over the top. Long triangular window strips let in light from a bright sun at the far end, and a pale moon is visible through the glass.
ARC-1975-AC75-1886: Construction of a giant ring-shaped space colony: the curved rim, half covered with transparent panels over green land and a river, arcs across the frame beside a tall metal spoke. Workers in spacesuits, a shuttle and small cargo pods float in the black starry space above.
ARC-1975-AC75-1918: A space station shaped like a cross floats among scattered stars, with large cylindrical modules at the ends of each arm and a long boom ending in a V-shaped antenna. Bright light strikes the white hull against the black sky.
ARC-1975-AC75-1920: Inside a vast enclosed space habitat, two curved valleys face each other across the open center, both covered with golden grassland, scattered trees and small lakes, with puffy clouds drifting between them. A dark eclipsed planet with a bright rim hangs in a window strip at the top, and two tiny figures stand on a hill at the bottom.
ARC-1975-AC75-1921: A loose cluster of cylindrical and dish-shaped space habitats and solar collectors is connected by thin lines and drifts through dark space toward the Earth. A small orange-red planet glows below the largest cylinder, and tiny spacecraft fly in formation near the top.
ARC-1975-AC75-1923: A base on the surface of the Moon: a numbered lander stands in the foreground beside a row of large white dish antennas, a smaller lander, and long cylindrical habitat modules half buried in the grey hills. The Earth rises over the horizon into the black starry sky.
ARC-1975-AC75-1924: Looking up through tropical trees and ferns inside a space habitat, terraced buildings and gardens rise in curved rings toward the sunlit hub overhead. A bright starburst of sunlight shines through, birds fly in the open air, and a sandy path winds along a rocky slope.
ARC-1975-AC75-2621: Inside an enormous ring-shaped space colony, a blue lake and green hills dotted with pine trees curve upward into the distance beneath a glass ceiling of blue window panels. In the foreground, people walk across a plaza between modern buildings, escalators and an open-air pavilion.
ARC-1976-AC76-0296: A space settlement under construction floats near a pale blue-white moon: a giant open ring with a mirrored inner face catches light from a large circular mirror, while a spacecraft with a solar wing hovers above. The background is a dark red cosmic cloud dotted with stars.
ARC-1976-AC76-0297: An astronaut in a spacesuit floats beside a huge flat white surface of a space colony under construction, next to a docked work shuttle with open cargo doors. A large banded planet rises behind the structure, and a lattice framework runs along the bottom.
ARC-1976-AC76-0525: Two ring-shaped space colonies float one above the other in deep starry space, each a wide wheel with spokes and a glowing central hub, connected by a long thin mast. A small solar panel array drifts to the right and another tiny wheel hangs from a tether on the left.
ARC-1976-AC76-0965: A spherical space colony with stacked ring-shaped farming sections and a long central mast floats in space, framed by large tilted mirror panels and two segmented orange and white rings. Docking modules sit at both ends, and the Earth and a small moon are visible against a purple and orange star cloud.
ARC-1976-AC76-1089: Looking into the open end of a huge cylindrical space colony, its inner walls are covered with green forest, villages and fields wrapped in a circle around a central hub. Large dark mirror panels and long support struts surround it, and a blazing sun with a small blue planet glow on the left.
ARC-1976-AC76-1267: A wheel-shaped space colony with spokes and a central hub tilts against a dense purple and magenta star cloud, with a flat disc-shaped mirror floating above it. A small blue planet, a distant smaller wheel, and a spacecraft trailing a thin line appear around it.
ARC-1977-AC77-0475-1: A rugged landscape of pitted, lumpy boulders and rock outcrops fills the foreground under a hazy pale orange and cream sky. A large dark mottled rock formation rises on the right and a faint sun glows through the clouds.
ARC-1977-AC77-0475-11: A small drum-shaped spacecraft with antennas and a dish floats in black space dotted with stars, approaching a large crescent planet covered in swirling pale yellow clouds that curves in from the lower right.
ARC-1977-AC77-0475-12: A glowing probe streaks across the sky like a meteor, trailing a thin red line as it enters the atmosphere of a planet. Below, a band of pink and violet light marks the horizon above a thick sea of white clouds.
ARC-1977-AC77-0475-2: A rocky alien landscape under a blazing orange sky: rolling dunes and wind-carved ridges stretch to the horizon while a bright smeared sun burns through the thick atmosphere. Craggy grey and pink boulders fill the foreground.
ARC-1977-AC77-0475-7: An aerial view over a volcanic plateau under a deep red sky, with a wide caldera at the center and columns of white steam rising from vents across the cracked rocky ground. Ridges and canyons stretch away to the hazy horizon.
ARC-1977-AC77-0475-8: Jagged spires of porous pale rock tower up on either side of a narrow valley, against a sky streaked with wavy horizontal bands of red and purple cloud.
ARC-1977-AC77-0475-9: A small domed probe sits among scattered rocks on a dusty orange plain, with wind-rippled dunes and rocky ridges rising behind it. The ground is covered with boulders and pebbles in the foreground.
ARC-1978-AC78-0238: A cylindrical spacecraft releases several cone-shaped entry probes that drift toward a large planet wrapped in pale banded clouds, while an orbiter with a dish antenna flies to the right. The background is a dark violet starfield with patches of orange cosmic dust.
ARC-1978-AC78-0330-1: An astronaut in a white spacesuit with a backpack and antenna stands on the grey surface of the Moon beside a rounded habitat module on legs, with a long track stretching toward the horizon. The Earth hangs in the black starry sky above.
ARC-1978-AC78-0330-2: Inside a circular control room under a domed ceiling of window panels, two operators sit at consoles covered with buttons, dials and screens, watching monitors that show vehicles moving across a grey lunar landscape. Round portholes look out onto the surface, and a central pole rises to the ceiling.
ARC-1978-AC78-0330-3: A bright living room in a space habitat with a coffered white ceiling, bookshelves, wooden cabinets and a wall console with small screens. Blue swivel chairs sit around a white table with papers and flowers, a fern hangs from above, and a wide window shows green rolling hills.
ARC-1978-AC78-0330-4: A cutaway section of a ring-shaped space colony reveals stacked farming compartments with green crop fields on the upper level and rows of livestock pens below. The curved white hull sweeps around against a deep blue starfield.
